name: Alorica (Partner)
desc:
Remote Financial CSR | $16/hr | Inbound
Company: Alorica
Industry: Financial Services / Call Center
What Your Day Will Look Like: You'd answer inbound calls from customers who have a question or concern about a product or service they've bought. Your job is to give them accurate answers quickly and leave them feeling taken care of. You'd update their records as you go, so the next person who talks to them knows what happened. Part of the job is taking payments by phone, and you'd also be expected to upsell where it fits, so you'd need to be comfortable suggesting an add-on in a helpful way. The posting doesn't name the client or the specific financial product, so ask about that early in the process.
assessment: Yes, Completing assessment is required to submit application
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent experience, highly preferred.
Required Experience: None required outright. 1 to 2 years of customer service experience with phone work is highly preferred.
Preferred Experience: Phone based customer service.
Required Skills:
Strong active listening and interpersonal skills
Clear oral and written communication
Ability to multitask and stay organized
PC proficiency
Attention to detail and accuracy
Analytical thinking and problem solving
Adaptable to change and motivated in a service environment
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with phone based customer service experience who likes solving problems on the spot
Someone comfortable taking payments by phone and suggesting add-ons in a friendly, helpful way
Someone who learns systems quickly and keeps accurate records
Someone looking for paid training, tuition reimbursement, and room to move up inside the company
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone who wants a role with no selling or upselling at all
Anyone who dislikes being on the phone most of the day
Anyone who needs a confirmed state eligibility list before applying, since the posting doesn't include one
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Inbound call handling
Phone based customer service
Phone payment processing
Account and record documentation
Upselling and add-on offers
Active listening
Multitasking
Problem solving
Customer inquiry resolution
Attention to detail
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process: 1. Application 2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you. 3. If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen. 4. If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview. Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your phone based customer service experience.
How do you keep a customer calm and still find the right answer for them?
How do you feel about taking payments over the phone and suggesting add-ons?
Walk us through how you keep accurate notes while you're talking with someone.
What does staying motivated look like for you in a high call volume job?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $16/hr, confirmed in posting.
Shift: Full-time and regular. Hours are not stated in the posting, confirm directly.
Benefits: Paid time off, 401(k), paid training, tuition reimbursement, remote onboarding and virtual training, and health, dental, and vision coverage with HSA options. Also an employee referral bonus program, employee discounts, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness resources, and free access to Alorica University for learning resources, leadership tracks, and certifications.
Equipment Provided: Not stated in posting.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated.
Drug Test: Not stated.
Notes: Alorica says 80% of its promotions come from within, and it's Great Place to Work Certified, which makes this a solid starting point for a participant who wants to build a career in contact centers. Training is paid, and tuition reimbursement is a real plus. This role is a separate financial services opening from the healthcare role already listed for Alorica. The posting says Remote but doesn't list eligible states, so confirm Oklahoma eligibility with the recruiter before referring someone. It also lists generating fees and upselling as a duty without explaining either, so ask what that involves.
Career Pathway: Not stated directly in posting, though Alorica says most promotions come from within. Reasonable inferred path: Financial CSR → Senior CSR → Team Lead → Customer Service Supervisor, though this is an estimate, not confirmed by Alorica directly.
